features.name: Carrie Murray Nature Center
features.description: Carrie Murray Nature Center is the park's year-round environmental-education hub, offering scheduled live-animal, preschool, camp, school, public and volunteer programs.

features.name: Orianda Mansion
features.description: Orianda Mansion, also mapped as Crimea Mansion, is the historic stone house at the center of the Crimea Estate landscape near Eagle Drive.

details.positionQuality: Orianda Mansion in the Crimea Estate area
details.coordinateSource: OpenStreetMap named building reviewed against the official Friends park map

features.name: Gwynns Falls Trail
features.description: The Gwynns Falls Trail is the park's principal shared walking and bicycling route, linking wooded Leakin Park segments to the larger Baltimore trail system.

details.positionQuality: Photographed Gwynns Falls Trail segment within Leakin Park

features.name: Magnolia Grove
features.description: Magnolia Grove is a seasonal collection of saucer magnolias in the Crimea section near Orianda Mansion, most visually distinctive during its brief spring bloom.

details.positionQuality: Magnolia Grove near Orianda Mansion in the Crimea section
details.coordinateSource: Wikimedia Commons photograph GPS and destination description
details.imageAlt: Magnolia Grove at Gwynns Falls Leakin Park

features.name: I-70 Park and Ride Trailhead
features.description: The former I-70 park-and-ride at the highway's eastern end is the official Friends map's Trail Head 1 and a practical western start for the park trail network.
